Frequently Asked Questions

GENERAL PRICING QUESTIONS

What currency does Spacelift use for pricing?

Spacelift is priced in U.S. dollars (USD).

Which payment methods can we use?

We accept multiple forms of payment, depending on the type of plan you choose. For example, the monthly subscription for the Starter plan can be paid for via a credit card. The Enterprise plan can be paid for via purchase order and invoice or with a credit card on a monthly or annual basis. Spacelift can also be purchased and paid via the AWS and Azure marketplaces. See additional information below.

What is a worker and how does it fit into the pricing structure?

A worker is a predefined set of compute resources that are specifically optimized for the development, provisioning, and deployment of cloud-based infrastructures based on IaC. Spacelift provides two types of workers: public and private. Free, Starter, and Starter+ all provide access to public workers. Starter+, Business, and Enterprise all offer private workers.

What's the difference between a public and a private worker?

Public workers are a type of worker that is provided and managed by Spacelift in a common secure worker pool. Each customer run is executed in its own isolated container instance. Although the underlying compute resources within the public worker pool are shared, runs do not have any access to the source or state of other accounts.

Private workers are a type of worker that are provided and managed by Spacelift, but are hosted as a customer-managed asset within their private cloud environment. They are securely connected to the Spacelift application for provisioning and management.

Can I adjust my plan if I decide I don't need all the features of my current plan?

Although we can’t remove features or remove workers from an annual subscription, if your usage or needs are lower than you anticipated, please contact sales and we will be happy to work with you. We have a number of options to help you right-size your plan so you can ensure you have what you need.

Are there multiyear subscription options?

Yes, Starter+, Business, and Enterprise can be purchased as multiyear subscriptions. Please request a quote to discuss multiyear agreements.

Are there partners or integrators that we can contact to purchase a subscription for Spacelift?

Yes, please contact the Spacelift Sales team for more information.

Do you offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations?

Yes, we offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations, please request a quote to learn more.

Are the plans available through the Amazon Marketplace?

Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Amazon Marketplace. You can find Spacelift under the SaaS product category and access the Spacelift page on Amazon Marketplace here.

Will procuring via the AWS Marketplace count towards my Private Pricing Agreement (PPA) commitment??

Yes, Spacelift qualifies as a SaaS partner to count towards your PPA commitment.

Are the plans available through the Azure Marketplace?

Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Azure Marketplace. You can find Spacelift under the SaaS product category and access the Spacelift page on Azure Marketplace here.

What comes with each subscription?

The Free plan includes 2 users and 1 public worker

The Starter plan is a monthly subscription that includes 10 users and 2 public workers.

The Starter + plan is offered either as a monthly or annual subscription and includes unlimited users, 2 public workers and 1 private worker.

The Business plan is offered as an annual subscription and includes unlimited users and 3 private workers.

The Enterprise plan is offered as an annual subscription and includes unlimited users and 5 private workers.

What are add-ons?

To give you added flexibility and ensure the plans will meet your needs at all stages of your growth, we’ve included additional capability packages that you can add to your plan.

STARTER AND STARTER+ PLANS

How does the Starter plan subscription work?

The Starter plan is a monthly subscription. It is electronically invoiced and payment is made via credit card.

How does the Starter+ plan subscription work?

The Starter+ plan is offered as an annual subscription. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

Can the Starter plan subscription be paid for annually?

Yes, the Starter plan can be paid for annually. Payment is made at the beginning of the term.

Can I cancel the Starter plan after the subscription starts?

Yes you can cancel the Sarter plan at any time after you start the subscription. Please note: When a plan is cancelled it will be valid until 11:59 pm EST the last day of the month in which it was cancelled.

Can I cancel the Starter+ plan after the subscription starts?

If you’re on a Starter+ annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.

Can I buy more than one public worker in Starter?

We offer the ability to add one additional public worker via self-service in the product on the Starter plan, but if you need more, you can contact the CS team.

BUSINESS PLAN

How does the Business plan subscription work?

The Business plan is offered as an annual subscription. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

Can the business plan subscription be paid for annually?

Yes, the Business plan can be paid for annually. Payment would be made at the beginning of the term.

Can I cancel the Business plan after the subscription starts?

If you’re on an annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.

Can I have more private workers in the Business plan?

Yes, you can purchase additional private workers when purchasing Spacelift, or you can add them after onboarding by getting in touch with the CS team.

ENTERPRISE PLAN

How does the Enterprise plan subscription work?

The Enterprise plan is offered as an annual subscription. In cases where a proof of concept is run, no further setup is required as the evaluation license is converted to a full license.

Can I cancel the Enterprise plan?

If you’re on an annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. After 14 days, the plan can’t be cancelled. If the software has been activated, the plan can not be canceled.

</div></div></div></div></div></section></div><section class="Faq_section__MTKzi" id="faq"><div class="Container_root__MDMPu"><div class="Faq_wrapper__fxwB7"><div class="Faq_titleWrapper__jGlDm"><h2 class="Faq_title__wtkv7 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleH3__4F0mv">Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div><div><div><p class="QuestionGroup_name__eB7rE Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS9__CStzO">General Pricing Questions</p><ul class="QuestionGroup_list__a1XA7"><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">What currency does Spacelift use for pricing?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Spacelift is priced in U.S. dollars (USD).</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Which payment methods can we use?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We accept multiple forms of payment, depending on the type of plan you choose. For example, the monthly subscription for the Starter plan can be paid for via a credit card. The Enterprise plan can be paid for via purchase order and invoice or with a credit card on a monthly or annual basis. Spacelift can also be purchased and paid via the AWS and Azure marketplaces. See additional information below.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">What is a worker and how does it fit into the pricing structure? </span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A worker is a predefined set of compute resources that are specifically optimized for the development, provisioning, and deployment of cloud-based infrastructures based on IaC. Spacelift provides two types of workers: public and private. Free, Starter, and Starter+ all provide access to public workers. Starter+, Business, and Enterprise all offer private workers.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">What's the difference between a public and a private worker?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Public workers are a type of worker that is provided and managed by Spacelift in a common secure worker pool. Each customer run is executed in its own isolated container instance. Although the underlying compute resources within the public worker pool are shared, runs do not have any access to the source or state of other accounts.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Private workers are a type of worker that are provided and managed by Spacelift, but are hosted as a customer-managed asset within their private cloud environment. They are securely connected to the Spacelift application for provisioning and management.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Can I adjust my plan if I decide I don't need all the features of my current plan?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Although we can’t remove features or remove workers from an annual subscription, if your usage or needs are lower than you anticipated, please <a href="https://spacelift.io/contact">contact sales </a></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">and we will be happy to work with you. We have a number of options to help you right-size your plan so you can ensure you have what you need.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Are there multiyear subscription options?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, Starter+, Business, and Enterprise can be purchased as multiyear subscriptions. Please <a href="https://spacelift.io/contact?refid=request-quote">request a quote</a></span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to discuss multiyear agreements.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Are there partners or integrators that we can contact to purchase a subscription for Spacelift?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, please <a href="https://spacelift.io/contact">contact the Spacelift Sales</a> team </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">for more information.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Do you offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, we offer pricing options for government and nonprofit organizations, please <a href="https://spacelift.io/contact?refid=request-quote">request a quote</a> to learn more.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Are the plans available through the Amazon Marketplace?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Amazon Marketplace. </div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Are the plans available through the Azure Marketplace?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, all of our plans are available for purchase through the Azure Marketplace. </div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">What comes with each subscription?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Free plan includes 2 users and 1 public worker</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Starter plan is a monthly subscription that includes 10 users and 2 public workers.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Starter + plan is offered either as a monthly or annual subscription and includes unlimited users, 2 public workers and 1 private worker.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Business plan is offered as an annual subscription and includes unlimited users and 3 private workers.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Enterprise plan is offered as an annual subscription and includes unlimited users and 5 private workers.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">What are add-ons?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">To give you added flexibility and ensure the plans will meet your needs at all stages of your growth, we’ve included additional capability packages that you can add to your plan.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li></ul></div><div><p class="QuestionGroup_name__eB7rE Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS9__CStzO">Starter and Starter+ Plans</p><ul class="QuestionGroup_list__a1XA7"><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">How does the Starter plan subscription work?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Starter</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">plan is a monthly subscription. It is electronically invoiced and payment is made via credit card.</span></p>
</div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">How does the Starter+ plan subscription work?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Starter+ plan is offered as an annual subscription. </div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Can the Starter plan subscription be paid for annually?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, the Starter plan can be paid for annually. </div></div></div></li><li><div class="Question_question__F_WVz" role="button"><span class="Question_questionText___3v08 Typography_styleBase__auQ0r Typography_styleS7__mLcU2">Can I cancel the Starter+ plan after the subscription starts?</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 25" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="25"><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M17.451 9.749a.85.85 0 0 1 0 1.202l-5.6 5.601-5.602-5.601a.85.85 0 1 1 1.202-1.202l4.4 4.399 4.398-4.399a.85.85 0 0 1 1.202 0Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><div class="Question_answer__uVqll Question_answerCollapsed__REMMl"><div class="Question_answerWrapper__mu2Um"><div class="bodyTextWrapper WysiwigContent_wysiwigContent__LTO_a"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re on a Starter+ annual plan, you can cancel up to 14 days after an executed contract if the software has not been activated. See additional information below.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n"},{"text":"What is a worker and how does it fit into the pricing structure? ","answer":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style=\"font-weight: 400;\"\u003eA worker is a predefined set of compute resources that are specifically optimized for the development, provisioning, and deployment of cloud-based infrastructures based on IaC. Spacelift provides two types of workers: public and private. Free, Starter, and Starter+ all provide access to public workers. Starter+, Business, and Enterprise all offer private workers.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n"},{"text":"What's the difference between a public and a private worker?","answer":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style=\"font-weight: 400;\"\u003ePublic workers are a type of worker that is provided and managed by Spacelift in a common secure worker pool. Each customer run is executed in its own isolated container instance. Although the underlying compute resources within the public worker pool are shared, runs do not have any access to the source or state of other accounts.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style=\"font-weight: 400;\"\u003ePrivate workers are a type of worker that are provided and managed by Spacelift, but are hosted as a customer-managed asset within their private cloud environment.
